about.title: About
about.lead: WanDaiser Games is a new independent studio making pixel art games for mobile.
about.body1: Every game we make is a small, hand-drawn world, built to be picked up in a spare minute and remembered for longer. We draw every pixel ourselves and care about the feel of each tap.
about.body2: We are working on several games right now. Each one becomes a star on this map when it is ready, and together they draw our constellation.
